wine.name: Wine 11.18 (WineHQ development release)
wine.note: Upstream, not CrossOver: the CrossOver 26.3 tree is Wine 11.0 and fails to load kernel32 when built for arm64 (c0000045); the ARM64 fixes it lacks landed upstream during 2026. Switches to CrossOver 27's sources when CodeWeavers publishes them (its DXMT driver table is the one piece this build cannot have until then).

llvm-mingw.name: llvm-mingw 20260922 (clang 23.1.2, ucrt, macOS universal)
llvm-mingw.note: The PE side needs clang for ARM64EC (arm64ec-w64-mingw32-clang) and lld 23 for the ARM64X link; Homebrew's gcc mingw-w64 cannot build either. The i386 half is built with the same toolchain's i686-w64-mingw32-gcc wrapper.

llvm-mingw-renderers.name: llvm-mingw 20250910 (clang 21.1.1, ucrt, macOS universal), for the renderers
llvm-mingw-renderers.note: The toolchain the MSFS 2024 runs' vkd3d-proton and DXVK were built with. clang 23.1.2 (llvm-mingw 20260922) refuses dxil-spirv's dxbc-spirv small_vector ("no matching member function for call to 'move'", build-renderers-arm64 run 38252336750).

fex.name: Hangover 11.16 DLLs: FEX 2608 as libarm64ecfex.dll (x86-64 through ARM64EC) and libwow64fex.dll (x86 through WoW64), MIT, used when build-arm64 is dispatched with fex_build: hangover
fex.note: Installed under Wine's default emulator names, xtajit64.dll and xtajit.dll, with the Darwin build of FEX's Unix helper (fex/fexunixlib_darwin.cpp) beside ntdll.so. Hangover's own helper is Linux-only and its absence makes FEX issue raw Linux syscalls, which macOS answers with SIGKILL.

fex-source.name: FEX 2610 source (MIT), built with fex/patches/ by build-arm64 (fex_build: source, the default)
fex-source.note: The submodules the Windows DLLs need, at the commits the tag records. Built with llvm-mingw for arm64ec (libarm64ecfex.dll) and aarch64 (libwow64fex.dll), Release, no LTO, generic tuning, then installed like Hangover's DLLs. The default since 2026-10-11 (the owner's decision). Hangover's build above stays available.

gstreamer.name: GStreamer 1.28.7, the official macOS framework (universal runtime and devel installer packages from gstreamer.freedesktop.org), mirrored unchanged in the release inputs-gstreamer-1.28.7 since 2026-10-15, when that site's CDN closed every transfer of them; the checksums are the originals'
gstreamer.note: Expanded flat with pkgutil and unpacked component by component (gstreamer/unpkg.py), never installed. The runtime components above are merged into frameworks/GStreamer.framework, then gstreamer/prune.py keeps the plugins winegstreamer can use for games and the libraries they link, thinned to arm64 (45 MB). Wine is built against a copy with the core and GLib headers from the devel package. 1.28.8 had no macOS packages on 2026-10-11. Both checksums match the ones published beside the packages.

toolchain.note: Native arm64 Unix side. The loader in the tarball is Wine's own and is replaced at install by Highball's signed one (the app's Contents/Helpers/WineLoader.app), which carries Apple's cross-architecture entitlement; without that entitlement nothing here starts on macOS 26.5 or later.

vkd3d-proton.name: vkd3d-proton 3.0.1 (Direct3D 12 on Vulkan), LGPL-2.1
vkd3d-proton.note: Tag v3.0.1, the base of every MSFS 2024 run on the arm64 engine (2026-10-11 and 12). Highball's changes are renderers-arm64/vkd3d-proton, built by build-renderers-arm64.yml.

dxvk.name: DXVK master of 2026-10-09 (DXGI, Direct3D 11 and 10 on Vulkan), zlib
dxvk.note: "[dxvk] Rework submission synchronization": the DXVK master the MSFS 2024 spike built on 2026-10-09 and every arm64 run since used. Highball's changes are renderers-arm64/dxvk.

moltenvk.name: MoltenVK 1.4.2 (Vulkan on Metal), Apache-2.0
moltenvk.note: The base of every MSFS 2024 run on the arm64 engine (the gin19 builds, 2026-10-11 and 12). Highball's changes are moltenvk-arm64/moltenvk, built by build-moltenvk-arm64.yml.

mesa.name: Mesa (KosmicKrisp, its Vulkan driver on Metal 4), MIT
mesa.note: Mesa main of 2026-10-05, the base of steamac's series in kosmickrisp-arm64/steamac. Highball's changes are kosmickrisp-arm64/highball.

Vulkan-Loader.name: Khronos Vulkan loader, Apache-2.0
Vulkan-Loader.note: Opens KosmicKrisp for Wine's winevulkan, as libMoltenVK.dylib in engine/lib. The version every Forza Horizon 6 run used (Homebrew's build of it).

Vulkan-Headers.name: Vulkan headers, for building the loader only, Apache-2.0

spirv-cross.name: SPIRV-Cross (SPIR-V to Metal Shading Language, inside MoltenVK), Apache-2.0
spirv-cross.note: MoltenVK 1.4.2's pinned revision. Highball's changes are moltenvk-arm64/spirv-cross.
